name: Days of Noble
source:
Ryugasaki Sylvaine in the main character's class is a rare classic lady at this time. Always show off the crazy naive and confuse the protagonists. One day, she suddenly missed school for a meaningful reason ...

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/19600]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主角班上的龙崎西尔薇恩，是如今已不多见的古典大小姐。她总是表现出超乎常理的不谙世事，让主角等人困惑不已。某天，她突然因为一个意味深长的理由没有来上学…
